what: The video instruction plan and every artifact a render of the three Law of Agency videos depends on. This freeze is what scripts/freeze-loa-curriculum.mjs hashes in place of the plan itself, so that correcting a video does not require breaking a curriculum freeze.

supersedesFreeze.reason: The repository-wide Texas source inventory grew when current provider-application and final-adoption sources were added. None of those files is consulted by a video render. Version 3 removes that inventory from the render boundary while continuing to hash the held IABS form, the held statute, every production artifact, the three target block maps, and both validating generators directly. All video wording, timings, coordinates, captions, and source pixels remain unchanged.

status.editorialAndLegalPackage: READY — at this freeze and not before it. Script, HeyGen prompt, storyboard and scene table, clean transcript, caption cue text, crop coordinates, highlight coordinates, duration metadata and poster specification are complete, source-verified and internally consistent.
status.renderedAssets: PENDING — no MP4, no shipping .vtt, no -poster.webp, no band PNGs, no diagram panels. Nothing has been rendered.
status.screenMediaIntegrationSupport: PENDING — scripts/lib/generate-tx-block-maps.mjs has no screenMedia hook, so there is no supported route to attach a video to a Texas screen. The tests the hook must ship with are recorded in that file's header.
status.coursePlacementActivation: NOT ACTIVE — no block map references any of these videos, and no student-facing surface carries a player, poster, badge, duration, play button or transcript link.
status.doNotSay: 'production-ready'. It collapses four layers into one and three of them are not ready.

supersedes.hashedBy: LOA-CONTENT-FREEZE-2026-08-30-v3, as the artifact 'video instruction plan'
supersedes.whySuperseded: v1 was correct when written and wrong in four particulars by the time it was frozen: it gave three durations that its own caption blocks contradicted, it said the Law of Agency block maps did not exist when they did, it said the caption files existed only inside the production files when they were on disk, and it described the screen ids as reservations when every one of them had been confirmed against a live generated screen. None of that was discoverable from the file itself, which is the point of recording it here.

Fixed at the root rather than by correcting the instance: every scene duration and every video duration is now DERIVED from that video's caption cue timeline, with the scene matched to its cues by comparing narration against cue text. There is one timeline and the tables are a view of it.

videos.title: Representation or Showing Only: the 2026 decision

validation.ranAt: freeze time — this artifact is not written if any check fails

checks.title: narration, transcript, captions and production prompt carry the same operative wording
every repaired legal qualifier appears in all four representations, by name
every scene duration derives from the caption timeline rather than being asserted alongside it
checks.notFullyMechanised: The cue timings these durations derive from are themselves PROVISIONAL — computed at 150 wpm, not measured from audio, because no render exists. This check proves the figures are derived from one timeline and cannot drift apart; it cannot prove the timeline is true to a render that has not been made.

checks.title: every crop keeps the complete official field or form language in frame
checks.notFullyMechanised: Verified in PDF-point space against the held page's own text lines. It cannot verify the RENDERED frame: no PNG has been built and no frame has been pixel-diffed against the page. That diff is a release gate.

checks.title: every highlight targets only the named concept
checks.notFullyMechanised: Geometry only. That a rectangle bounds whole printed words, and bounds nothing outside itself, is mechanical. That the words it bounds are THE CONCEPT THE NARRATION NAMES — and not a neighbouring provision that happens to be word-aligned — is a reading judgment this script does not make. Each rectangle's intended target is named in prose beside it in §6, and that pairing is what a human reviewer checks.

checks.title: all 50 form strings still verify against the held IABS-1-2.pdf
no correction exists only in the addendum
checks.notFullyMechanised: The enumeration of what the addendum records is authored, not derived: this script cannot read the addendum's prose and discover a correction nobody listed. It proves that every LISTED correction is present canonically, and that the addendum declares itself non-operational. Adding a correction to the addendum without adding it here would evade the check — which is why corrections belong in the canonical files first.

checks.title: the canonical v2 package is sufficient to render without consulting superseded files
checks.notFullyMechanised: Sufficiency is tested as the presence of every ingredient a render needs and the absence of any pointer to a superseded file. Whether the prose in those sections is good enough to render FROM is an editorial judgment; whether it renders correctly is answerable only after a render.

assessmentSeparation.derivedFrom: the generated block maps themselves, re-read on every validator run
assessmentSeparation.statement: Retrieval happens on a separate screen. Each video attaches to its unit's -s1 instruction screen; the unit's practice screen -s2 follows; the retrieval check is -s3, which the generator emits as { id, sequence, type: 'retrieval', title, questionId } with NO content range and NO media field of any kind. When the student reaches the retrieval screen the video, the highlighted form and the five visible answers are no longer displayed — they belong to -s1, two screens behind.
assessmentSeparation.alsoTrue: No video contains a quiz question, a self-test, a poll, an answer or an answer recap. No answer is revealed immediately before a retrieval check. Every video ends on the avatar with no document and no panel on screen, so no highlight is up when the student is asked to retrieve.

afterFreeze: No video wording, coordinate or duration may change silently. A correction found later must break THIS freeze explicitly, name the artifact and the reason, re-run the validator, and create a new video-freeze version with new hashes. It does not require a curriculum-freeze break: the curriculum freeze follows this artifact's hash. Re-taking this freeze under the same id is forbidden — an id denoting two byte-states is not an identifier.
notApproved: StateCourse holds no TREC approval for this course or as a qualifying education provider. Nothing in these videos, their captions, their posters, their transcripts, their production files or this artifact states or implies that the videos, the course, or StateCourse is approved, endorsed, reviewed or licensed by the Texas Real Estate Commission. The form shown is the Commission's; the instruction wrapped around it is StateCourse's.
